Name: Anime Catboy Portrait Mod - Wizard Update SVE
Author: thakyZ
Description:
[size=5]🪄 [u]Stardew Catboy Edit - Wizard Update 4 SVE [/u]
[/size]
[b]ALL CREDIT goes to Gigi's portraiture mod and Lilico's wizard portrait edit, as well as Jellonip's Gigi Portrait update for the Wizard, and lastly but most importantly FinnsInn for the original catboy edit![/b] Please check out the original mods if you haven't, their art is beautiful!

This mod adds edits to make the wizard into a catboy [s]as well as
making the sprites[/s] (Still attempting to get permission from the original author of the srpites) for the portraits work with Stardew Valley Expanded.


[u][size=4][i]INCLUDES:[/i][/size][/u]
Wizard (Magnus) | Bombay (Compatible with the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url]﻿ mod!)

[size=4]
[/size][size=4][i][u]ORIGINAL MODS:[/u][/i][/size]
[b]Gigi's Hi-Res Portraits mod for All Characters[/b]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3759]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3759[/url]﻿
[b]lilico's Gigi Portrait Edits (Chaekal's Wizard) for LfL[/b]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4103]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4103[/url]﻿
[b]FinnsInn's Anime Catboy Portrait Mod[/b]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5487]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5487[/url]﻿
[b]Jellonip's Romanceable Rasmodius Redux Revamped(RRRR)(SVE Required)[/b]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16893]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16893[/url]﻿

[u][b][size=4][i]Installation Guide[/i][/size]:[/b][/u]
1. Install the required mods
2. Unzip the mod file
3. [s]Add it into Stardew Valley\Mods\Portraiture\Portraits\[/s] Drop into the [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley\Mods[/font] folder as it is already packaged to work alongside Gigi's
4. Open the game and select the portrait by p﻿ressing P while talking to the NPC!
